validation.source: COCO train2017, different images from the KB

test.scene_types: simple = 0-2 objects, medium = 3-5, complex = 6 or more

preprocessing.images: EXIF rotation fixed, converted to RGB, resized + normalised by the CLIP processor
preprocessing.captions: caption_raw = original (evaluation), caption_clean = lowercase + no punctuation (retrieval only)
preprocessing.metadata: objects and scene type from the COCO annotations (no detector used). Colours, shapes, context and spatial relations are estimated from caption words because COCO does not provide them. eval_objects.json (validation + test) is for evaluation only, never for retrieval
